title: Revised Conditions for V-CIP of Politically Exposed Persons

paragraphs.text: Reference is invited to paragraph 6 of circular GZ-KYC-2020-01 dated July 10, 2020, which prescribes the conditions for using the Video-based Customer Identification Process for Politically Exposed Persons. Based on the experience gained with V-CIP, it has been decided to raise the credit limit applicable to such accounts.

With effect from October 1, 2023, paragraph 6 of circular GZ-KYC-2020-01 dated July 10, 2020 on V-CIP for Politically Exposed Persons stands substituted by the text set out in paragraph 3 of this circular, which shall thereafter be read as paragraph 6 of circular GZ-KYC-2020-01.

V-CIP for Politically Exposed Persons: the Video-based Customer Identification Process may be used for onboarding a Politically Exposed Person only with the prior approval of senior management, and an account of a Politically Exposed Person opened through V-CIP shall not receive aggregate credits exceeding Rs 25 lakh in a financial year until in-person verification is completed.

Additional safeguards for V-CIP of PEPs: a Video-based Customer Identification Process session for a Politically Exposed Person shall be conducted by an official not below the rank of Chief Manager, and the recording of the session shall be reviewed by the compliance function within seven working days.

The enhanced due diligence measures for Politically Exposed Persons in circular GZ-AML-2020-02, including senior management approval, establishing the source of funds and enhanced ongoing monitoring, shall continue to apply to every Politically Exposed Person onboarded through the Video-based Customer Identification Process.

All other provisions of circular GZ-KYC-2020-01 on eligibility, consent, live location, liveness check and recording retention for V-CIP remain unchanged. The revised conditions for V-CIP of Politically Exposed Persons shall be effective from October 1, 2023.
